tasks.label: Compile Project (Default)
tasks.command: rmdir /s /q build 2>nul & cmake -G Ninja -S . -B build & cmake --build build --target firmware

tasks.label: Compile Project (CRC32, Protection Level 0, Randomized ISA)
tasks.command: rmdir /s /q build 2>nul & cmake -G Ninja -S . -B build -DBCDEMO_PROGRAM=crc32 -DBCDEMO_PROGRAM_ENCRYPTED=OFF -DBCDEMO_PROTECTION_LEVEL=0 -DBCDEMO_ROUTE_MODE=random-free & cmake --build build --target firmware

tasks.label: Compile Project (Checksum, Protection Level 1, Randomized ISA)
tasks.command: rmdir /s /q build 2>nul & cmake -G Ninja -S . -B build -DBCDEMO_PROGRAM=checksum -DBCDEMO_PROGRAM_ENCRYPTED=ON -DBCDEMO_PROTECTION_LEVEL=1 -DBCDEMO_ROUTE_MODE=random-free & cmake --build build --target firmware

tasks.label: Compile Project (Checksum, Protection Level 2, Randomized ISA)
tasks.command: rmdir /s /q build 2>nul & cmake -G Ninja -S . -B build -DBCDEMO_PROGRAM=checksum -DBCDEMO_PROGRAM_ENCRYPTED=ON -DBCDEMO_PROTECTION_LEVEL=2 -DBCDEMO_ROUTE_MODE=random-free & cmake --build build --target firmware

tasks.label: Clean
tasks.command: rmdir /s /q build 2>nul & rmdir /s /q arm_host\build 2>nul & rmdir /s /q arm_worker\build 2>nul & rmdir /s /q riscv_worker\build 2>nul
